title: Seedance Video Watermark Removal: Current Support and Workflow
description: Learn what the Seedance Watermark Remover MVP supports today and how extracted frames fit the future video-processing roadmap.
heading: A clear path from extracted frames to future video support
intro: The current MVP does not accept MP4 or MOV files. It can process an authorized still frame while the provider abstraction remains ready for a dedicated video backend.

faq.question: Which video formats are supported?
faq.answer: None yet. Direct video upload is not implemented.

faq.question: Can I upload a frame from a Seedance video?
faq.answer: Yes, if it is JPG, PNG, or WebP, no larger than 10 MB, and you own or may edit the source.

faq.question: Will audio or motion be preserved?
faq.answer: The current image workflow does not process video, audio, timing, or motion.
